name: Awaritia
source:
The leader of the Black Knights, [spoiler] and the last one to be killed. He's in fact the corrupted and reanimated version of Georgius of the Rainbow, one of the strongest members and apostles of Index, and the leader of the Punishment Squad, who fought and sealed Liselotte. He was revived by [url=https://vndb.org/c3152]Misao[/url].[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://11eyes.fandom.com/wiki/Avaritia]11eyes wiki[/url]]
